fibtransponder: Fibonacci Streaming State Machine

Research & Implementation (Go) · 2026

An experimental tokenization and semantic sensing substrate built around a Fibonacci-radix streaming state machine (FSVM). Evaluates bounded per-step work bitstream ingestion, structural calibration via adjacency width, and Zobrist hash seed tables.

CASE: 02 / 05

Impact

Demonstrated that structural adjacency width acts as a locality-sensitivity selector; falsified seed-only detector diversity through automated corpus benchmarks.
